description:
Title: Internship

You can enter a topic that interests you, and how much money you want.
You can also enter experience and hobbies.
Several offers will arrive (at arbitrary points in time).
You can accept or deny offers.
As soon as an offer is accepted, all other offers become invalid.
You have to write at least 3 status updates about your internship (every week).
The company has to write 3 status updates about you.
After the internship is finished you can recommend the company to a list of friends (via twitter).
Separate tweets are sent in parallel.

<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Internship"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Offer" name="Internship offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Acceptance" name="Offer acceptance" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Start_CompanyUpdates" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweets" name="Recommendation tweets" sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Message_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetails</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ReceiveOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_OfferDecision</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_DenyOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_AcceptOffer</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Week1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate1</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Week2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate2</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_Week3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_StatusUpdate3</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_InternshipFinished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Event_NextWeek</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_FurtherStatusUpdate</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_Recommend</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SendTweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_Recommended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NotRecommended</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Internship" name="Start"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" name="Enter topic of interest and desired amount"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetails" name="Enter experience and hobbies?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" name="Enter experience and hobbies"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" name="Continue to offers"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveOffer" name="Receive an offer" messageRef="Message_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept or deny offer?"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_AcceptOffer" name="Accept offer and invalidate all other offers" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week1" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Week1">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate1" name="Write weekly internship status update 1"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week2" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Week2">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate2" name="Write weekly internship status update 2"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_Week3" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_Week3">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_StatusUpdate3" name="Write weekly internship status update 3"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InternshipFinished" name="Internship finished?" default="Flow_NextWeek"/>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_NextWeek" name="One week passes">
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerDefinition_NextWeek">
        <bpmn:timeDuration xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">P7D</bpmn:timeDuration>
      </bpmn:timerEventDefinition>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_FurtherStatusUpdate" name="Write weekly internship status update"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Recommend" name="Recommend the company to friends?"/>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendTweet" name="Send a recommendation tweet to a friend" messageRef="Message_Tweet">
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false">
        <bpmn:loopCardinality xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">numberOfFriends</bpmn:loopCardinality>
      </bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_Recommended" name="Recommendation tweets sent"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NotRecommended" name="Internship finished without recommending the company"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A1" sourceRef="Start_Internship" targetRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A2" sourceRef="Task_EnterTopicAndMoney" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A3" name="Enter details" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">enterExperienceAndHobbies</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A4" name="Skip details" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetails" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A5" sourceRef="Task_EnterExperienceAndHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A6" sourceRef="Gateway_OptionalDetailsMerge" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A7" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A8" name="Deny" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">denyOffer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A9" name="Accept" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">acceptOffer</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A10" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A11" sourceRef="Task_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Event_Week1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A12" sourceRef="Event_Week1" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A13" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate1" targetRef="Event_Week2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A14" sourceRef="Event_Week2" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A15" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate2" targetRef="Event_Week3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A16" sourceRef="Event_Week3" targetRef="Task_StatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A17" sourceRef="Task_StatusUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A18" name="Finished" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Gateway_Recommend">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">internshipFinished</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NextWeek" name="Not finished" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished" targetRef="Event_NextWeek"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A20" sourceRef="Event_NextWeek" targetRef="Task_FurtherStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A21" sourceRef="Task_FurtherStatusUpdate" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipFinished"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A22" name="Recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="Task_SendTweet">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recommendCompany</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A23" name="Do not recommend" sourceRef="Gateway_Recommend" targetRef="End_NotRecommended">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">doNotRecommend</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_A24" sourceRef="Task_SendTweet" targetRef="End_Recommended"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Company" name="Company status updates" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_Company">

      </bpmn:lane>

      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Acceptance" messageRef="Message_Acceptance"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C3" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate2" targetRef="Task_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_C4" sourceRef="Task_CompanyUpdate3" targetRef="End_CompanyUpdates"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
